description: This file defines the CountryService class, which manages CRUD operations and queries related to Country and Province entities within the OrangeHRM system. It interacts with the CountryDao data access object to retrieve country and province data and provides methods to retrieve normalized data for frontend or other layers.

classes.name: CountryService
classes.description: Service class responsible for managing Country and Province data, including retrieval and normalization of lists and specific entities.

methods.name: getCountryDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the CountryDao instance.

methods.name: getCountryList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of all countries.

methods.name: getProvinceList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of all provinces.

methods.name: getCountryByCountryName
methods.description: Fetches a Country entity based on the country name.

methods.name: getCountryByCountryCode
methods.description: Fetches a Country entity based on the country code.

methods.name: getProvinceByProvinceCode
methods.description: Fetches a Province entity based on the province code.

methods.name: getCountryArray
methods.description: Provides a normalized array of country data suitable for frontend processing.

methods.name: getProvinceArray
methods.description: Provides a normalized array of province data.
